description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single hybrid attacks (0.60 or 1.50 each), grants [Twin Element Mode II (Ice, Dark)], [Awoken Commanding Officer], [Damage Cap +10000], [(Ice/Dark) Ability +30% Boost (15s)] and [Instant Cast 2] to the user

description.name: Awoken Commanding Officer
description.text: Ice and Dark abilities don't consume uses, Ice and Dark abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice and Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Twin Element Mode II (Ice, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice with Stacking]/[Attach Dark with Stacking] after using a Ice/Dark ability

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: (Ice/Dark) Ability +30% Boost (15s)
description.text: Ice and Dark abilities deal 30% more damage
